summary_en: ¥90/share annual dividend (¥60 prior), +¥30/share increase. Year-end dividend raised to ¥90 from ¥60. Driven by ~¥5.5 billion special gain from sale of all Bitbank shares to SBI Holdings and others; net proceeds ~¥7.4 billion after tax to be allocated to share buyback (up to ¥2.5 billion) and shareholder returns. Board authorized on 2026-06-25.
title_en: Notification of Revision to Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending December 2026
translation_en_brief: On 25 June 2026, Ceres Inc.'s board approved (1) execution of a binding agreement with SBI Holdings and others regarding the sale of all shares in Bitbank Inc., a company accounted for using the equity method, and (2) revision of the FY12/26 dividend forecast. The company now expects a full-year dividend of ¥90 per share, an increase of ¥30 from the prior forecast of ¥60 per share. The year-end dividend is raised to ¥90 from ¥60, with no interim dividend. The sale of Bitbank is expected to generate a special gain of approximately ¥5.5 billion in consolidated earnings (approximately ¥6.8 billion in standalone earnings). After deducting tax, net proceeds of approximately ¥7.4 billion are to be allocated to share buybacks (up to ¥2.5 billion, in addition to approximately ¥500 million in buybacks completed on 17 June 2026) and broader shareholder returns. The company states its policy of balancing dividend returns with maintaining a sound financial foundation and internal reserves for future business expansion. The dividend increase reflects strengthened shareholder return policy enabled by the Bitbank transaction. Full details of the buyback program are to be announced following board approval of specific terms, pending satisfaction of conditions in the basic agreement.
